hooks.command: python3 -c "import json, sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); sys.exit(2) if any(x in p for x in ['.env','.env.','secrets/','credentials']) else sys.exit(0)"

PreToolUse.description: Block writes to sensitive files (.env, secrets, credentials)

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); patterns=[r'rm\s+-rf\s+[/~]', r'git\s+push\s+.*--force', r'DROP\s+TABLE', r'DROP\s+DATABASE']; sys.exit(2) if any(re.search(p,cmd,re.I) for p in patterns) else sys.exit(0)"

PreToolUse.description: Block dangerous bash commands (rm -rf /, force push, DROP TABLE)
